subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Utilizar o conhecimento sobre as radiações e suas origens para avaliar as potencialidades e os riscos de sua aplicação em equipamentos de uso cotidiano, na saúde, no ambiente, na indústria, na agricultura e na geração de energia elétrica.

components.description_pt: Identificar origens e tipos de radiação presentes em contextos cotidianos
components.description_en: Identify the origins and types of radiation present in everyday contexts
components.cc_component_description: Identify wave-based technologies used in everyday life and scientific research

components.description_pt: Avaliar benefícios potenciais do uso de radiação em saúde, indústria, agricultura e geração de energia
components.description_en: Evaluate potential benefits of radiation use in health care, industry, agriculture, and energy generation
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate how social regulations influence the risks and benefits associated with a specific energy source

components.description_pt: Avaliar riscos potenciais de exposição à radiação de equipamentos cotidianos e fontes ambientais
components.description_en: Evaluate potential risks of radiation exposure from everyday equipment and environmental sources
components.cc_component_description: Identify economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks associated with energy production or resource extraction

cc_matches.description: All forms of energy production and other resource extraction have associated economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks as well as benefits. New technologies and social regulations can change the balance of these factors.

Multiple technologies based on the understanding of waves and their interactions with matter are part of everyday experiences in the modern world (e.g., medical imaging, communications, scanners) and in scientific research. They are essential tools for producing, transmitting, and capturing signals and for storing and interpreting the information contained in them.
